rules.title: Every editable sketch primitive has a required persistent reference
rules.requirement: Each ordered rectangle edge and each ordered circle primitive must be captured with GetPersistReference3 under its exact feature-id plus semantic-subobject key.
rules.failure: Block host delivery when any required sketch reference is absent or cannot be resolved immediately.

rules.title: Semantic keys are unique
rules.requirement: The native topology catalog must contain one unambiguous persistent reference per reference_key.
rules.failure: Block on duplicate keys, conflicting persistent bytes, or unordered profile primitives.

rules.title: BREP classification is mathematical
rules.requirement: Faces and edges are classified from exact profile parameters, endpoint coordinates, analytic surface type, radius, and extrusion depth; projected pixels and volatile feature-tree names are not topology truth.
rules.failure: Ambiguous or missing derived BREP candidates stay non-authoritative instead of being guessed.

rules.title: Catalog is embedded before native save
rules.requirement: Every resolvable persistent reference must be stored in deterministic AICAD_REF_0001-style document properties together with semantic type, native type, classification, required flag, and reference bytes.
rules.failure: A transient in-memory report is insufficient evidence.

rules.title: Save and reopen are separate gates
rules.requirement: After SLDPRT save, reopen the native file, enumerate only ordinal AICAD_REF_NNNN properties, decode each reference, and call GetObjectByPersistReference3.
rules.failure: Block if the catalog is empty or any required reference is unresolved.

rules.title: Catalog identity survives reopen
rules.requirement: The Python adapter must compare the exact saved and reopened reference-key sets and reject missing, unexpected, or duplicate keys.
rules.failure: A matching feature count, volume, or bounding box cannot substitute for topology identity.

rules.title: Native authority is evidence-bound
rules.requirement: native_topology_authority may be true only after real SolidWorks execution, native save, reopen, key-set equality, and zero unresolved required references.
rules.failure: Offline plans and semantic multiview projections must continue to declare native topology authority false.

rules.title: COM wrapper lifetime is protected
rules.requirement: Do not FinalReleaseComObject on an object returned by persistent-reference readback while the caller may still hold the same runtime callable wrapper.
rules.rootCausePrevented: SolidWorks can return the same RCW for the original face or edge and the resolved reference; final release disconnects both handles.

rules.title: Metadata properties cannot masquerade as reference records
rules.requirement: The reopen reader accepts only AICAD_REF_ followed by exactly four decimal digits.
rules.rootCausePrevented: A broad prefix match also consumes AICAD_REF_COUNT and produces a malformed-record failure.

rules.title: Geometry and safety locks remain independently verified
rules.requirement: Body count, body faults, volume, bounding box, fully constrained sketches, feature errors, source hash, and review locks remain mandatory alongside topology readback.
rules.failure: Topology persistence alone never constitutes engineering or manufacturing acceptance.
